title: Lost kingdoms on the high street
excerpt: Wessex, Mercia and Northumbria vanished more than a thousand years ago, but their names are still on shop signs. 75 of 95 Wessex businesses are in Wessex, and all 33 Northumbria businesses are in Northumbria.
seo_description: Do businesses named after Wessex, Mercia or Northumbria sit inside the old kingdoms? 75 of 95 Wessex names are in Wessex.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Lost kingdoms on the high street' beside a map of Britain with rough outlines of early medieval kingdoms and coloured dots for businesses named after them.
